entry.title: Created the first four-page Jev catalogue with an evidence-led report, comparison tables, and fit-check widget.
Recorded current launch-week use cases, alternatives, project evidence, access routes, and price uncertainty.
Added a plain-English What is Jev? ELI5 page while preserving the four required catalogue destinations.

Refreshed the official Jev model ID, aliases, endpoint, price, limits, context, text-only input, access ambiguity, and legal/data terms from current TypeSafe pages; no verified production-product finding was changed.
Separated current OpenRouter and Cloudflare listings from the inaccessible Vercel lead and the independent proxy, preserving the proxy's self-reported 10× higher price and remaining gaps.
Added the dated access, pricing, availability, and data-terms report for the regular run while retaining the bootstrap report and source trail.

Published the 21 September alternatives refresh: retained all six rows and substitution layers, made the local-only verification boundary visible, kept every current project field unknown, and recorded that no open-weight Jev model was verified.
Added the dated alternatives verification report with the runner boundary, retained direct URLs, unknowns, negative finding, and follow-up checks.

Refreshed the six alternatives with direct-source evidence and a layer-by-layer substitution matrix; kept mini-jev unverified and preserved the negative finding that no open-weight Jev model was verified.
Added the dated alternatives substitution report with source ledger, evidence boundaries, builder guidance, and explicit unknowns for model, interface, runtime/privacy, workflow, cost, and latency.

Updated the products page with the 23 September bounded adoption audit: killmyidea is a direct-source Jev application with public-deployment metadata but unverified access and adoption; the other leads remain an unofficial integration, mocked demo, reference harness, or lead index; no verified production product was found.
Added the dated adoption and product verification report with direct source links, evidence labels, deployment boundaries, the public-host access failure, and the preserved negative finding.

Updated the home, use-cases, alternatives, products, and where-to-use pages with the 24 September builder branch, task-fit and measurement boundary, six-row substitution labels, bounded product status, and proposed maintenance note.
Added the Run 4 builder-fit and maintenance synthesis with direct source links, dated evidence gates, bounded unknowns, proposed maintenance rules, and no-independent-measurement statement.
Corrected independent proxy tiered self-reported rates, recorded the TypeSafe MCA displayed 23 Sep update with exact diff unknown, and dated the waitlist observation without implying open signup.
Added a bounded 24 Sep trigger report while preserving 20 Sep access, 22 Sep alternatives, and 23 Sep product evidence dates and negative-finding scope.

Added a support-ticket Choice evaluation protocol with separate cohorts, labelled gold cases, frozen comparators, failure-inclusive denominators, review-load reporting, and blank results; no Jev call or benchmark was run.
Added a small fit-stage link on the home and use-cases pages to the unfilled workload protocol, with the no-measured-result boundary explicit.
Rebuilt every catalogue page, updated the fit tool, added open-weight Jev-like alternatives, direct-source project inventory, Netlify and Vercel access caveats, and complete dated research history.
Added full direct-source report and bounded 24-hour platform monitor while retaining eight earlier reports as historical records.
